title: 10. Editing Essay Lengkap & Pemolesan Transcript Speaking
blocks: Self-editing terpadu dalam kondisi ujian: checklist enam pass, lima essay utuh yang penuh kesalahan untuk diperbaiki (dari yang paling banyak salahnya sampai yang paling sedikit), dan lima jawaban speaking untuk dinaikkan satu band tanpa terdengar seperti hafalan.

Di setiap bab sejauh ini, Anda memperbaiki satu jenis kesalahan dalam satu waktu, dan sudah tahu sebelumnya apa yang harus dicari. Ujian sungguhan tidak seperti itu. Dalam essay sungguhan, semua aturan dari Modul 1 sampai 3 berlaku sekaligus, kesalahannya bercampur dan tidak diberi label, dan Anda harus menemukan kesalahan Anda sendiri di bawah tekanan waktu tanpa kunci jawaban di samping Anda. Modul terakhir ini melatih tepat keterampilan itu: self-editing terpadu. Anda akan memperbaiki essay utuh yang mengandung semua jenis kesalahan, lalu meningkatkan jawaban speaking sungguhan dari aman-tapi-dasar menjadi terkontrol-dan-fleksibel.

Setiap tugas editing di bawah ini adalah satu essay atau paragraph utuh yang penuh kesalahan, ditulis kira-kira di level Band 5.5 sampai 6.0, dan sengaja diisi jenis-jenis kesalahan yang sudah Anda pelajari. Bekerjalah dengan urutan yang disiplin, bukan membaca secara acak untuk mencari “hal-hal yang terlihat salah.”
Agreement pass: periksa setiap verb terhadap subject-nya yang sebenarnya (Bab 1).
Tense pass: periksa apakah setiap time frame benar dan konsisten (Bab 2).
Article pass: periksa a / an / the / zero di depan setiap singular noun (Bab 3).
Preposition pass: periksa dependent preposition dan data preposition (Bab 4).
Structure pass: periksa apakah ada fragment, run-on, dan comma splice; pastikan ada variasi complex sentence (Bab 5).
Range pass: apakah ada setidaknya satu passive, satu conditional, dan sedikit hedging di tempat yang sesuai (Bab 6, 7)? Apakah ada satu high-band structure yang akurat (Bab 8, 9)?

Lakukan pass terpisah untuk setiap item. Mencoba menangkap semuanya dalam sekali baca adalah penyebab kesalahan lolos; saat proofreading, pemeriksa yang fokus pada satu hal selalu lebih unggul daripada yang memeriksa semuanya sekaligus.

Ada lima essay editing di exercise bab ini, diurutkan dari yang paling banyak kesalahannya (Essay 1) sampai yang paling sedikit (Essay 5). Masing-masing punya versi model yang sudah dikoreksi dan rincian kesalahan per kategori, sehingga Anda bisa melihat pass mana dari enam pass Anda yang akan menangkap setiap kesalahan. Kerjakan secara berurutan; essay-essay berikutnya menganggap Anda sudah menguasai perbaikan pada essay sebelumnya.

Anda tidak sedang menulis ulang essay itu dengan gaya Anda sendiri. Anda hanya membuat koreksi minimum yang dibutuhkan untuk ketepatan dan range, sambil mempertahankan makna penulisnya. Itulah persis yang harus Anda lakukan pada script Anda sendiri di lima menit terakhir ujian.

Grammar juga dinilai di Speaking, dengan kriteria Grammatical Range and Accuracy yang sama, tetapi targetnya berbeda: di Speaking Anda butuh fleksibilitas yang terkontrol secara real time, bukan kepadatan tulisan. Lima soal speaking di exercise memberi Anda jawaban lisan sungguhan yang dasar-tapi-aman, dan meminta Anda menaikkannya satu band dengan menambahkan tepat teknik-teknik yang diajarkan kursus ini, tanpa membuatnya terdengar seperti hafalan.
Perangkat peningkatan untuk Speaking, diurutkan dari yang paling bernilai:
Perbaiki ketepatan dasar dulu: agreement, tense, dan article, karena kesalahan di sini paling banyak mengurangi nilai.
Tambahkan satu complex sentence: clause dengan because, although, atau which untuk menghubungkan dua ide.
Tambahkan kontras tense: berpindah antara past, present, dan future untuk menunjukkan range (“I used to … but now I … and I think I'll …”).
Tambahkan satu frasa hedging: “it depends,” “I'd say,” “on the whole,” “tend to.”
Jika mau, satu cleft yang alami untuk penekanan: “what I really enjoy is …”

Tujuannya adalah bahasa Inggris lisan yang akurat dan fleksibel, bukan paragraph hafalan. Satu complex sentence yang alami dan satu kontras tense dalam jawaban Part 2 akan lebih membantu nilai Anda daripada idiom yang dihafalkan.
Mengapa editing terpadu adalah keterampilan ujian yang sesungguhnya

Kedua writing task sebaiknya diakhiri dengan beberapa menit untuk editing, dan kandidat yang melakukan editing secara sistematis biasanya mendapat setengah band lebih tinggi di Grammatical Range and Accuracy dibanding yang tidak, karena kesalahan kecil yang sama (-s yang hilang, article yang terlewat, will di dalam if-clause) sangat umum sekaligus mudah ditangkap dengan pass yang terarah. Di Speaking, kemampuan melakukan self-correct dengan lancar (“the number of people were, sorry, was rising”) justru menjadi tanda positif bahwa Anda mampu mengontrol bahasa. Bab ini membangun kebiasaan yang mengubah semua yang sudah Anda pelajari menjadi nilai dalam kondisi ujian.

Skill yang terbantu: Writing, Speaking
Manfaat editing: Edit enam pass yang sistematis di lima menit terakhir biasanya menghilangkan sebagian besar kesalahan agreement, tense, dan article.
Self-correction di Speaking: “They has — sorry, they have — improved a lot recently.”
Lima essay editing dan lima soal pemolesan speaking ada di exercise bab ini. Bab 11 kemudian memberikan answer key lengkap, langkah demi langkah, untuk setiap exercise di buku ini.

title: 10. Practice · Editing Essay Lengkap & Pemolesan Transcript Speaking
blocks: Mencoba menangkap setiap kesalahan grammar dalam sekali baca adalah penyebab kesalahan lolos. Jalankan pass terpisah yang fokus pada satu hal untuk setiap aturan -- agreement, lalu tense, lalu article, lalu preposition -- karena saat proofreading, pemeriksa yang fokus selalu lebih unggul daripada yang memeriksa semuanya sekaligus.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Checklist ini menyatukan semua bab sebelumnya menjadi satu rutinitas editing yang bisa diulang dan dijalankan pada essay apa pun sebelum Anda mengumpulkannya.
1. **Agreement pass** -- periksa setiap verb terhadap subject-nya yang sebenarnya (Bab 1).
2. **Tense pass** -- periksa apakah setiap time frame benar dan konsisten (Bab 2).
3. **Article pass** -- periksa a/an/the/zero di depan setiap singular noun (Bab 3).
4. **Preposition pass** -- periksa dependent preposition dan data preposition (Bab 4).

Lakukan **pass terpisah untuk setiap item**, jangan mencoba menangkap semuanya dalam sekali baca. Saat proofreading, pemeriksa yang fokus selalu lebih unggul -- pass yang fokus pada satu hal menangkap kesalahan yang sama sekali terlewat dalam pembacaan umum.

blocks.title: Exercise 10.1 · Editing Essay Lengkap
blocks.instructions: Lima essay yang penuh kesalahan, diurutkan dari yang paling banyak sampai yang paling sedikit kesalahannya. Jalankan checklist enam pass pada masing-masing dan tulis ulang dengan benar, sambil mempertahankan makna penulisnya. Essay 5 juga meminta Anda menambahkan satu high-band structure.

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 1 (heavily flawed). Correct every error, preserving the meaning. “In many country, the number of student who go abroad for study have increased in recent years. This trend have both advantage and disadvantage. On one hand, student who studies in foreign university gets access to better facility and they can learns new culture. On other hand, it is very expensive and many family cannot affords it. In my opinion, if government will provide more scholarship, this problem can be solved. According to me, the advantage is more than the disadvantage.”
items.answer: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
accepted: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
items.reason: Agreement: country→countries, student→students, have→has (the number bersifat singular), studies→study, gets→gain, learns→learn, affords→afford. Article: on the one hand, on the other hand, the government. Conditional: “if government will provide”→“if the government provided … could be solved” (tidak ada will di dalam if-clause). Register: “According to me”→“Overall / In my view”; “advantage is more than”→“advantages outweigh the disadvantages.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 2. Correct every error. “Nowadays, technology have changed the way we communicate. In the past, people was writing letters which take many days to arrive. But now, we can sends a message in a second. Although this is convenient, but it also have some negative effect. For example, many young people spends too much time on their phone and they forgets how to talk face to face. If this trend continue, our social skill will became weaker.”
items.answer: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
accepted: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
items.reason: Agreement: have→has, can sends→send, have→has, spends→spend, forgets→forget, skill→skills. Tense: “was writing”→“wrote” (kebiasaan di masa lalu), “take”→“took.” Structure: “Although … but” adalah connector ganda—hapus “but.” Conditional: “if … continue … will became”→“continues … will become” (base verb setelah will). Plural/article: effect→effects, phone→phones.

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 3. Correct every error. “Pollution is one of the most serious problem in the world today. The main cause of it are the vehicles and the factories. In big cities, the air quality have become very poor, and many people suffers from breathing disease. Government should took strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we do something about this issue.”
items.answer: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
accepted: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
items.reason: Agreement: problem→problems (setelah “one of the most”), cause … are→causes are, have become→has become (subject-nya “quality”), suffers→suffer, disease→diseases. Bentuk verb: “should took”→“should take.” Article: “the vehicles and the factories”→bentuk umum “vehicles and factories”; “Government”→“Governments.” Mixed conditional-nya sudah benar (“had acted … would not be … now”). “It is high time” diikuti past subjunctive: “we did,” bukan “we do.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 4 (lightly flawed). Correct every error. “There is many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offers more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, the access to good education and healthcare are better. However, urban life also have its drawbacks, such as pollution and high cost of living. Despite of these problems, the majority of people still prefers city life.”
items.answer: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
accepted: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
items.reason: Agreement: “There is many”→“There are many,” offers→offer, “access … are”→“access … is” (subject-nya “access,” singular), have→has, prefers→prefer (subject “majority of people” di sini diperlakukan sebagai plural). Preposition: “Despite of”→“Despite” (tanpa “of”). Article: “a high cost of living.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 5 (subtle errors + one range upgrade). Correct the errors, then add ONE high-band structure (an inversion, a cleft, or a nominalisation) where it fits. “Renewable energy has become more important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This is a positive development, but it is also expensive. Not only it reduces emissions, it also creates jobs. The transition will take time, but it is necessary.”
items.answer: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
accepted: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
items.reason: Teks dasarnya hampir akurat; perbaikan utamanya adalah inversion: “Not only it reduces”→“Not only does it reduce …, but it also creates” (urutan kata seperti pertanyaan setelah “not only” yang diletakkan di depan). Peningkatan opsional yang ditunjukkan: “increasingly important” untuk register, “This shift” sebagai subject hasil nominalisation yang menjaga cohesion, “the transition to clean energy” untuk kepadatan.

blocks: Speaking dinilai dengan kriteria Grammatical Range and Accuracy yang sama seperti Writing, tetapi targetnya berbeda: fleksibilitas yang terkontrol secara real time, bukan kepadatan tulisan. Perbaiki ketepatan dasar dulu, lalu tambahkan satu complex sentence dan satu kontras tense.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Kandidat sering terlalu banyak menyiapkan grammar untuk Writing dan kurang menyiapkan kriteria yang sama untuk Speaking, padahal tujuannya berbeda.
Perangkat peningkatan untuk Speaking, diurutkan dari yang paling bernilai
1. **Perbaiki ketepatan dasar dulu** -- agreement, tense, dan article, karena kesalahan di sini paling banyak mengurangi nilai.
2. **Tambahkan satu complex sentence** -- clause dengan because, although, atau which untuk menghubungkan dua ide.
3. **Tambahkan kontras tense** -- berpindah antara past, present, dan future untuk menunjukkan range: I used to..., but now I...

Bahasa Inggris lisan yang akurat dan fleksibel -- bukan paragraph hafalan. Satu complex sentence yang alami dan satu kontras tense dalam jawaban Part 2 akan lebih membantu nilai Anda daripada idiom yang dihafalkan.

blocks.title: Exercise 10.2 · Pemolesan Transcript Speaking
blocks.instructions: Lima jawaban lisan yang dasar-tapi-aman. Naikkan masing-masing satu band dengan memperbaiki ketepatan dasar dan menambahkan satu complex sentence, satu kontras tense, dan satu frasa hedging, tanpa membuatnya terdengar seperti hafalan.

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 1. Raise this Part 1 answer one band, keeping it natural. “Yes, I like reading. I read many book. My favourite is story book. I read every day because it is relaxing.”
items.answer: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
accepted: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
items.reason: Perbaiki: “many book”→“a lot of books,” “story book”→“fiction.” Tambahkan range: clause dengan because, frasa hedging (“I'd say”), dan penekanan mirip cleft (“it's the best way … to unwind”), ditambah peningkatan tense/register.

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 2. Raise this Part 1 answer one band. “I live in Dhaka. It is big city. There is many people. I like it because my family is here.”
items.answer: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
accepted: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
items.reason: Perbaiki: “big city”→“a very large … city,” “There is many”→“there are a lot of.” Tambahkan range: relative clause (“which is …”), clause kontras (“Although …”), dan clause alasan (“because …”).

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 3. Raise this Part 2 answer one band. “I want to talk about my phone. I use it every day. It is very useful. I use it for call and internet. I cannot live without it.”
items.answer: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
accepted: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
items.reason: Perbaiki: “for call”→“for making calls.” Tambahkan range: pembuka berupa cleft (“The possession I'd like to talk about is …”), relative clause, frasa hedging (“honestly … I'm not sure”), dan sentuhan conditional (“how I'd manage without it”).

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 4. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Yes, technology changed our life. Before, people did everything by hand. Now, machine do the work. I think it is good.”
items.answer: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
accepted: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
items.reason: Perbaiki: “changed”→“has changed,” “life”→“lives,” “machine do”→“machines … handle.” Tambahkan range: clause kontras (“Whereas … used to …”), kontras tense (kebiasaan masa lalu vs present), hedging (“On the whole, I'd say”), dan konsesi (“though it does have …”).

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 5. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Government should help poor people. They can give money and job. If they do this, poverty will reduce.”
items.answer: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
accepted: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
items.reason: Perbaiki: “Government”→“governments,” “poor people”→“people living in poverty,” “give money and job”→“providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities.” Tambahkan range: second conditional (“If … were implemented … would be likely to fall”), hedging (“be likely to”), dan clause konsesi.
